40007751.author: पदार्थः
40007751.content: निशाचरः demon, प्रतिकूलम् adversely, राजवत् royal, आज्ञप्तः commanded, मारीचः Maricha, राक्षसाधिपम् to the king of the demons, परुषम् harsh, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् said.

40007751.author: Translation
40007751.content: At this royal command which was against his interest Maracha used harsh words to the demonking:

40007752.author: पदार्थः
40007752.content: निशाचर Ravana, सपुत्रस्य with your sons, सराष्ट्रस्य with the kingdom, सामात्यस्य with the ministers, ते to you, अयम् this, विनाशः destruction, पापकर्मणा sinful action, केन by whom, उपदिष्टः advised.

40007752.author: Translation
40007752.content: Who is that sinner who has given you this advice which will spell destruction on you, your sons, your kingdom and your ministers ?

40007753.author: पदार्थः
40007753.content: राजन् king, कः who, पापकृत् sinner, सुखिना happy one, त्वया by you, नाभिनन्दति not tolerate, मृत्युद्वारम् death gate, इदम् this, केन by whom, ते you, उपायतः cunningly, उपदिष्टम्  advised.

40007753.author: Translation
40007753.content: Which sinner is not able to see you happy? O king by whom is this gate of death shown to you cunningly?

40007754.author: पदार्थः
40007754.content: तव your, शत्रवः enemies, हीनवीर्याः deprived of valour, निशाचराः demons, त्वाम् you, बलीयसा by a strong person, उपरुद्धम् obstructed, विनश्यन्तम् being destroyed, इच्छन्ति they like, सुव्यक्तम् it is very clear,

40007754.author: Translation
40007754.content: This is clear that your enemy demons are now powerless. Hence they want you to be engaged with a stronger power and be destroyed.

40007755.author: पदार्थः
40007755.content: निशाचर O nightwalker (Ravana), यः he who, त्वाम् to you, स्वकृतेन by your own action, नश्यन्तम् being destroyed, इच्छति wishes, क्षुद्रेण by a mean fellow, अहितवादिना one who gives wrong advice, केन by whom, इदम् this, ते to you, उपदिष्टम् advised.

40007755.author: Translation
40007755.content: O Ravana by which mean fellow is this advice given against your welfare? Who wants you to be destroyed by your own action.

40007756.author: पदार्थः
40007756.content: रावण Ravana, उत्पथम् wrong path, आरूढम् you ascended, त्वाम् you, ये those, सर्वशः by all means, न निगृह्णन्ति do not prevent, तव सचिवाः your ministers, वध्याः खलु deserve to be slayed, न हन्यन्ते they are not slain?

40007756.author: Translation
40007756.content: O Ravana the ministers should have prevented you by all means from adopting this  wrong path. Since they have not done so, they deserve to be spain.

40007757.author: पदार्थः
40007757.content: कामवृत्तः lustful, कापथम् evil path, आश्रितः resorted to, राजा king, सद्भि: by the good people, अमात्यैः by ministers, सर्वथा always, निग्राह्यः हि should be stopped, निग्राह्यः prevent, न निगृह्यसे not prevented.

40007757.author: Translation
40007757.content: Good ministrers should always prevent a lustful king from taking resourse to an evil path. Why were you not stopped, even though you deserve to be checked.

40007758.author: पदार्थः
40007758.content: जयताम् among the successful, वर best, निशाचर demons, Ravana, सचिवाः ministers, धर्मम् righteousness, अर्थं च prosperity, कामं च and pleasures, यशश्च and fame, स्वामिप्रसादात् by the grace of the king, प्राप्नुवन्ति attain.

40007758.author: Translation
40007758.content: O Ravana  the best among the successful ministers attain piety, prosperity, pleasures and fame by the grace of the king.

40007759.author: पदार्थः
40007759.content: रावण Ravana, विपर्यये if it be otherwise, तत् then, सर्वम् everything (the four attainments), व्यर्थं भवति will become useless, स्वामि वैगुण्यात् by the vices of the king, इतरे जनाः others, व्यसनम् calamity, प्राप्नुवन्ति suffer.

40007759.author: Translation
40007759.content: Otherwise evrything will become useless, O Ravana  Others will suffer calamities on account of their master's vices.

40007760.author: पदार्थः
40007760.content: जयताम् among the victorious, वर best one, धर्मश्च righteousness, जयश्च victory, राजमूल: the king is the root, हि indeed, तस्मात् therefore, सर्वासु in all, अवस्थासु stages, नराधिपाः kings, रक्षितव्याः deserve to be protected.

40007760.author: Translation
40007760.content: O Ravana, the best among the victorious indeed the king is at the root of righteousness and victory.Therefore, the king should be protected by all at every stage.

40007761.author: पदार्थः
40007761.content: राक्षस demons, निशाचर nightwalker, तीक्ष्णेन by a rude one, राज्यम् kingdom, पालयितुम् to rule, न शक्यम् is not possible, प्रतिकूलेन by a hostile one, न not, अविनीतेन by an impolite one, न not.

40007761.author: Translation
40007761.content: O nightwalking demon  a kingdom cannnot be governed by a king who is rude or hostile or impolite.

40007762.author: पदार्थः
40007762.content: ये whoever, सचिवाः ministers, तीक्ष्णमन्त्राः who adopt improper strategies, मन्दसारथयः when the charioteer is driving slow, शीघ्राः swiftly, तुरगाः horses, विषमे यथा on a rugged surface, likewise, तेन by that, सह along with, भज्यन्ते वै are overthrown.

40007762.author: Translation
40007762.content: Ministers who adopt improper strategies go down along with the king just like swift horses driven by a slow charioteer on a rugged terrain.

40007763.author: पदार्थः
40007763.content: लोके in this world, युक्ताः engaged, धर्मम् rightful duty, अनुष्ठिताः following, बहवः many, साधवः pious, परेषाम् of others, अपराधेन by their mistakes, सपरिच्छदाः along with their kith and kin, विनष्टाः ruined.

40007763.author: Translation
40007763.content: Persons who walk the righteous path go down in this world along with their kith and kin due to the mistakes committed by others .

40007764.author: पदार्थः
40007764.content: रावण Ravana, प्रतिकूलेन by an unfavourable, तीक्ष्णेन by a rude one, स्वामिना by the  master, रक्ष्यमाणाः protected, प्रजाः people, गोमायुना by a jackal, मेषाः यथा like sheep, न वर्धन्ते do not grow.

40007764.author: Translation
40007764.content: O Ravana, people who are ruled by a cruel and hostile king will not grow like the sheep protected by a jackal.

40007765.author: पदार्थः
40007765.content: रावण O Ravana, येषाम् of whom, कर्कशः  rude , दुर्बुद्धि: evilminded, अजितेन्द्रियः having no control over the senses, त्वम् you, राजा king, सर्वे all, राक्षसाः demons, अवश्यम् surely, विनशिष्यन्ति perish.

40007765.author: Translation
40007765.content: Under a rude, crooked king whose senses are not under his control the demons will surely perish.

40007766.author: पदार्थः
40007766.content: मया I, काकतालीयम् accidental, घोरम् dreadful, तत् that, इदम् this, आसादितम् reached, अत्र here, किम् what, त्वम् you, शोचनीयः deplorable, ससैन्यः along with your army, विनशिष्यसि   will perish.

40007766.author: Translation
40007766.content: I am faced with  this dreadful disaster accidentally. You will not only be in a miserable state because of your misdeeds, you will perish along with your army.

40007767.author: पदार्थः
40007767.content: रामः Rama, माम् me, निहत्य after killing, न चिरात् soon, त्वाम् you, वधिष्यति will kill, अरिणा by the enemy, हतः slayed, म्रियेयम् I will die, अनेन by this, कृतकृत्यः accomplished, अस्मि I will be.

40007767.author: Translation
40007767.content: Rama will kill you not long after killing me.Hence even if I die in the hands of the enemy, my desire will be fulfilled.

40007768.author: पदार्थः
40007768.content: रामस्य Rama's, दर्शनादेव by mere sight, माम् me, हतम् a dead one, अवधारय presume, सीताम् Sita, हृत्वा abducting, सबान्धवम् along with your kith and kin, आत्मानम् yourself, हतम् killed, विद्धि  understand.

40007768.author: Translation
40007768.content: Yu most understand that if I die at the very sight of Rama, you along with your relatives will perish with the abduction of Sita.

40007769.author: पदार्थः
40007769.content: मया सहितः along with me, आश्रमात् from the hermitage, सीताम् Sita, आनयिष्यसि चेत् if you bring, त्वम् नैव असि you will not survive, अहं च I also, न लङ्का nor Lanka, नैव not, राक्षसाः demons, न not.

40007769.author: Translation
40007769.content: If you bring Sita from the hermitage with my assistance, know that none of us will surviveyou nor I, nor Lanka , nor the demons.

40007770.author: पदार्थः
40007770.content: निशाचर Ravana, हितैषिणा by your wellwisher, मया by me, निवार्यमाणः  warned, इदम् this, वाक्यम् words, न मृष्यसे do not comprehend, गतायुषः men of reduced life span, परेतकल्पाः almost dead, नराः people, सुहृद्भि: by friends, ईरितम् told, हितम्  good advice, न गृह्णन्ति हि not accept.

40007770.author: Translation
40007770.content: O Ravana, you do not understand this word of warning coming from your wellwisher. Men who are going to die do not heed the advice given by their friends. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे एकचत्वारिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fortyfirst sarga of Aranyakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
